messages:
ryan: Heads-up: /uploads/create API examples are inconsistent. Some samples use `input_format: \"plain_text\"`, some use `\"text/plain\"` (MIME). Runtime accepts either but OpenAPI currently lists enum `plain_text|html`. Need canonical choice and a short migration note.

maria: Oh yeah, saw user confusion on support. Product prefers MIME strings (text/plain, text/html) to avoid ambiguity. Devex warning: changing enum values in OpenAPI will affect generated clients.

oliver: Technical: runtime normalizes both to a canonical token internally. If we choose MIME in docs, we'll need to mark the existing non-MIME values as deprecated in schema description rather than removing them. That keeps codegens stable.

ryan: Plan: update API ref examples to use MIME values, add a migration snippet showing how to normalize user inputs, and annotate OpenAPI property description with "Deprecated values: plain_text, html" rather than deleting. I'll open a PR.

devex-sam: Devex note: after docs merge we'll open a separate OpenAPI PR so client regen can be scheduled. Also prepare small SDK helpers to accept both shapes for one release and emit the canonical MIME in new examples.

maria: For examples, please update curl/python/js. Please include tiny one-liners to coerce old labels: Python `fmt = 'text/plain' if v == 'plain_text' else v` and TS `const fmt = v === 'plain_text' ? 'text/plain' : v;`. Also call out server-side normalization.

ryan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10001 12 — adds examples and migration paragraph. I included a small example test harness that verifies the preview accepts both shapes.

devex-sam: Left two comments: 1) show both request body JSON and header-based example for uploads (we have both patterns elsewhere), 2) add a unit check in the examples harness asserting final normalized_format === 'text/plain' for the sample.

oliver: Added a suggestion to the PR to add a short note in the API reference: "Prefer MIME types for future compatibility" and a bullet about SDKs shipping a helper.

docs-bot: docs-bot: preview built -> https://deploy-preview-10001--docs.redwood.ai. Examples render showing `text/plain`. Harness tests passed.

maria: LGTM. Devex: when you open the OpenAPI PR, please include the exact `enum` diff and call out deprecation text so reviewers know it's docs-first.

devex-sam: Will do. I'll coordinate client regen after the OpenAPI merge. For now, merging docs is safe since runtime accepts both.

ryan: Merged. Will follow up with a short changelog entry and a paste-ready support message. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
